notes.title: Version 1.0 locked and release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
Howdy all!

As of last night, The Ambassador's Coterie has reached a '1.0' state! There was a lot of last minute work on the project, from updating the sprites some to a complete re-write and full editing of large parts of the script. The result is that the game's looking and feeling pretty polished now and will be hitting its March 20th release date!

(That's in seven days!)

As an example, here's what the sprite rework for Ambassador Gauss looked like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42042905/1ab0664362ae8c92ff6d44d34efe1d1bad1e879a.png[/img]

Thank you for your wishlists and we hope that you enjoy the full release.

If you'd like a press copy of the game to review it with, please feel free to contact the developer directly at icecreamrush@hersecretsmile.com. The game should launch March 20th at around 4PM EST (GMT-5).
